_readme: English text for everything that is not post content: the theme's own strings, the ACF
options-page values, the navigation menus and the Contact Form 7 forms. Read and applied by
tools/en-setup.php. Keys are the Ukrainian source text, never a database id, so this file
still applies after the catalogue migration re-runs against a fresh production dump.
Post content lives in dict/ instead and is applied by tools/en-translate.php.

seo_source._readme: The same Rank Math templates were written in Russian but stored as the Ukrainian (default-language) original, so Ukrainian pages showed Russian titles and descriptions. en-setup.php writes the uk text into the option and the WPML string, and keeps the Russian text as the ru translation. Placeholders must survive verbatim.
